Appointment of Shri P.K. Malhotra as Secretary, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice with effect from 7th December, 2012(AN).

Sh. K.P. Pathak, Sr. Advocate, appointed as Additional Solicitor General of India in the Calcutta High Court.
